_comment: Curated screenshot list. Sources live in the gitignored qa-shots/ working directory; the committed artifact is the JPEG built by scripts/build-gallery.mjs. Add an entry here and re-run the script to include a new shot.

shots.title: First launch over Austin
shots.caption: Google photorealistic 3D tiles under the sensor HUD: classification banner, MGRS and lat/lon readout, GSD and NIIRS, and the mission-control launcher. Cesium ion and Google Maps attribution stays visible, as their licences require.

shots.title: Live street traffic over Westminster
shots.caption: 2,213 vehicles tracking the London road network from OpenStreetMap geometry and TomTom flow. The HUD reverse-geocodes the view unprompted — here, Big Ben and Parliament.

shots.title: Submarine cables, global
shots.caption: 712 cable routes and 1,917 landing points from TeleGeography — 2,629 entities of static reference geometry.

shots.title: Saved places
shots.caption: Bookmark the complete view — camera, style, layers, panels — and replay it mid-session. ALL replays everything; POS replays position only.

shots.title: Colosseum, Rome
shots.caption: GSD 0.10 m — the sharpest site in the set. The hypogeum floor is legible inside the arena.

shots.title: Chichén Itzá, Mexico
shots.caption: GSD 0.11 m. El Castillo centre-frame with the Temple of the Warriors and the ball court.

shots.title: Great Pyramid of Giza
shots.caption: Full photogrammetry — the pyramid mass and the mastaba field, with Cairo behind.

shots.title: Taj Mahal, Agra
shots.caption: GSD 0.17 m. The complex, its four minarets and the charbagh gardens, with the Yamuna beyond.

shots.title: Christ the Redeemer, Rio de Janeiro
shots.caption: The statue on the Corcovado summit with Rio and the Atlantic behind. This framing took three attempts — see docs/DESTINATIONS.md.

shots.title: Grand Canyon, South Rim
shots.caption: Mather Point. Terrain rather than photogrammetry, but the relief carries it.

shots.title: Niagara Falls
shots.caption: GSD 0.22 m. Horseshoe Falls centre-frame with the whole cataract.

shots.title: Matterhorn
shots.caption: The peak against sky, glaciers and the Alps behind.

shots.title: Uluru
shots.caption: Layered flanks and the red plain running to the horizon.

shots.title: Grand Prismatic Spring, Yellowstone
shots.caption: Blue centre, orange bacterial mats, and the Firehole River.

shots.title: Iguazú Falls
shots.caption: GSD 0.29 m. The full cataract system on the Argentina–Brazil border.

shots.title: Yosemite Valley
shots.caption: Framed from Tunnel View — granite walls and the Sierra crest beyond.

shots.title: Orbit — start
shots.caption: Press O after flying to a destination and the camera circles it at about 6°/sec, a full revolution in roughly a minute. These three frames are the same landmark ~7 seconds apart.

shots.title: Fort Bragg — Pope Field
shots.caption: The Pope Field runway, taxiways and hangar line. GSD 0.28 m.

shots.title: Fort Benning — Airborne School
shots.caption: The 250 ft free-fall towers around the circular landing field. Shown in the CRT style the app now opens in.

shots.title: Fort Sill — Old Post
shots.caption: The historic Old Post quadrangle and the artillery park.

shots.title: Conflict watch — Eastern Mediterranean
shots.caption: The Conflict watch saved place recalled: live vessels, civil and military flights, and mapped installations, at 150 km. NASA FIRMS is deliberately off — see docs/CONFLICT-VIEW.md for why.
